title: Service calls per day
intro: A field-service team logged how many calls it receives per day. X is the number of calls, from 0 to 4, with the probabilities in the table. Read the mean μ = 1.80 calls (the long-run average per day), the variance σ² = 1.46 calls² and the standard deviation σ = 1.21 calls. The value of interest k = 2 shows P(X = 2) = 0.25.
